name: Empire of the Golden Witch
source:
How deep you dig is up to you.

Determining if you've found the truth is up to you.

---

This is an Umineko no Naku Koro Ni fangame. Knowledge of the series is mandatory to fully enjoy and understand the game.

This is an Umineko fanwork unlike any you've read up to this point. Taking place in an alternate world -- the extent of which I cannot share here, I'm afraid -- you take control of a woman, sifting through records of a strange database. The smell of coffee lingers in the air. The night is long.

What will she find?

More importantly -- what will you?

The gameplay is simple: all you have to do is dig for the truth. How far you dig, how much of the truth you know -- or, you believe you know -- is entirely up to you. There is no ending, just as there is no beginning. Dig until you don't want to. Theorize. Have someone else play it and exchange notes -- maybe someone's gotten a piece of information you haven't?

When you're satisfied, walk away.

The truth is out there, just as much as it may be in here.

[From game's [url=https://dwam.itch.io/empire-of-the-golden-witch]Itch.io Page[/url]]
translation:
挖多深由你决定。

确定是否找到真相取决于你。

---

这是一款海猫的同人游戏。为了充分享受和理解游戏，必须了解该系列的知识。

这是一部与你迄今为止读过的任何同人作品不同的海猫同人作品。故事发生在另一个世界——恐怕我无法在这里分享其范围——你控制一个女人，筛选一个奇怪数据库的记录。空气中弥漫着咖啡的香味。夜很长。

她会发现什么？

更重要的是——你会做什么？

游戏玩法很简单：你所要做的就是挖掘真相。你挖掘得有多深，你知道多少真相——或者，你相信你知道——完全取决于你。没有结束，就像没有开始一样。挖到你不想挖为止。理论化。让其他人玩它并交换笔记——也许有人已经获得了你没有的信息？

当你满意了，就走开。

真相就在那里，就像它在这里一样。

[来自游戏的 [url=https://dwam.itch.io/empire-of-the-golden-witch]Itch.io页面[/url]]
